items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Milt Hinton. My first recording he was on. ... I was scared to death anyway. But Milt Hinton, and he came in and just guided me right through it.

ctx.x: Yeah. Milt Hinton too. Guys like that.
Milt Hinton. My first recording he was on.
